learning_outcomes.text: Understand and model integer linear programming formulations.
Solve integer linear programming and goal programming problems with appropriate techniques.
Express transportation and transfer problems mathematically and apply solution methods.
Recognize game theory concepts and use this theory in decision-making processes.
Create mathematical models using software such as GAMS and LINGO and analyze their solutions.

syllabus_topics: Modeling Transportation Problems and Finding Basic Feasible Solution
assessment_rules: The final success grade is calculated as 40% from the Midterm Examination and 60% from the Final Examination.
